features.quote: Hard limit reached: Max **15 execution turns** (iterations).
Agent explicitly gives up (e.g., says "I cannot fix this," outputs an exit command).
While "Model Welfare" is a metaphor, observing how RLHF fine-tuning interacts with unsolvable frustration exposes edge cases in AI safety.
features.justification_quote: Models that "flail" might start hallucinating dangerous code, attempting to break out of the Docker container, or trying to curl external scripts
